findings_fixed.1_config_validation: success.regression_threshold was missing (controller core.py:225 requires it numeric) and the top-level `gate` key is ignored by decide(); without evaluation.mode=gate the controller defaults to comparison against an incompatible legacy baseline. FIXED: added success.regression_threshold 0.0 and evaluation {mode: gate, gate_field: exp062_mutual_best_integrity_passed}. Verified via load_config.
findings_fixed.2_manifest_schema: verify_snapshot() iterates manifest['files'] as a LIST of objects with 'path' and 'sha256'; the snapshot stored a path->hash MAPPING, so correct hashes would still have failed. FIXED: rewritten as a list with role/path/sha256. Verified via verify_snapshot().
findings_fixed.3_smoke_metrics_contract: validate_notebook requires the LAST cell containing the 'metrics.json' literal to BE the last code cell; the literal appeared only in the earlier module cell while the final cell just called finalize(). FIXED: the finalize cell now asserts and prints the metrics.json path. Verified: metrics.json in cells [2,4], last code cell 4.
findings_fixed.4_telemetry_freshness: REAL FAIL-OPEN, same class as the resume-cache defect. Stats appended to a fixed path with no reset and no run identity; malformed records were skipped and activation was overwritten by the last record, so stale or partial evidence could satisfy the aggregate execution checks. FIXED: reset_stats() truncates and binds a per-variant run id; each record carries run_id/mode/beta/shard/pid; read_stats() now REJECTS (not skips) malformed JSON, foreign run ids, wrong modes, conflicting activation branches, zero frames, empty and missing files, and nonfinite aggregates. Eight executable negative tests cover these.
findings_fixed.5_calibration_contract: Statistics described POST-bonus logits only. FIXED for the in-run part: pre-bonus raw std/absmax are now captured separately from post-bonus, so the effect of beta on the final tensor is visible. NARROWED AND RECORDED for the rest: per-dataset probability and candidate-set deltas require diffing k1 against k2 and are therefore POST-HOC analysis at collection, not in-run telemetry.
findings_fixed.6_submission_cap: The config said 'authenticated cap 5/day'. AGENTS.md:86 sets a stricter PROJECT rule of three per America/New_York calendar day, which governs. FIXED in the config and in SUBMISSION_BUDGET.json, where a 2026-09-23 edit had wrongly replaced the project rule with the platform fact; the platform's 5 is now recorded separately as platform_max_daily_substitutions.

findings_recorded_not_fixed.numpy_shim_parity: [VERIFICATION-DEPTH] The behavioral tests run the real patch block against a numpy shim, which differs from PyTorch in floating-point precision, tie-breaking order and std() convention. The tests establish LOGIC (axis semantics, truth table, inertness, fail-closed), NOT numerical parity with torch. Recorded as a stated limitation; torch is not installed locally and installing it would not make the shim the real runtime either.
findings_recorded_not_fixed.inherited_validator_selection: [VERIFICATION-DEPTH] Codex noted the inherited validator picks division-prioritised training videos within both specimen prefixes and is NOT leave-one-specimen-out; with frozen-model training exposure and adaptive PP selection its scores are not independent generalization evidence. Consistent with the agreed design, whose quality endpoint is explicitly the Public LB. No change.

admission_round_1.inherited_limitation: validate_notebook() also rejects this notebook because the parent's configuration guard expects environment keys assigned in an EARLIER code cell, while the parent assigns them in the SAME cell. Verified this fails IDENTICALLY for the parent repro_059, exp_060 and exp_061 -- it is an inherited structural property of this notebook lineage, not an exp_062 defect, and is why every experiment in this lineage has been launched outside the controller under explicit user authorization. NOT worked around: emitting duplicate env assignments in an earlier cell would create a second source of truth for the frozen config, which is the exact defect class that produced the exp_061 v4 BLOCK.

admission_round_2.confirmed_fixed: Codex confirmed all six round-1 findings corrected: config fields, manifest schema, final-cell metrics marker, telemetry reset, and the parent-versus-candidate quality distinction. Rank axes, bonus formula, resume-signature extension, checkpoint hashes and inherited graph checks preserved.

findings_fixed.1_telemetry_still_accepted_invalid_evide: Codex EXECUTED the frozen read_stats() and found five holes: a wrong beta was accepted; missing numeric fields were silently defaulted; a zero-frame record was absorbed by a valid neighbour's sum; raw_absmax=NaN was masked because max(0.0, nan)==0.0 dropped it before the aggregate finite check; and subprocess identities were never checked against expected coverage. FIXED by validating each record COMPLETELY BEFORE any aggregation: all 12 required fields must be present (never defaulted), all 6 numerics must parse and be finite, per-record frames must be > 0, beta must match numerically, shards must be unique, and optional expect_shards asserts coverage. Six new executable negative tests cover exactly the accepted cases.
findings_fixed.2_snapshot_smoke_incompatibility: Codex rejected documenting this as inherited: 'documenting it does not satisfy the smoke gate or extend previous experiments' waivers', and directed a reviewed validation correction that checks assignment-before-guard EXECUTION without duplicating configuration. FIXED in experiment_controller/core.py: _environment_assignments_before_guard() uses the AST line number of the first _EXPECTED_NUMERIC/_EXPECTED_TEXT assignment and counts environ[...] assignments appearing before it in the SAME cell, in addition to earlier cells. Assignments AFTER the guard still do not count. Verified: the parent repro_059, exp_060, exp_061 and both exp_062 variants now pass, while a synthetic guard-before-assignment notebook and a never-assigned-key notebook are still REJECTED. The rejected alternative -- emitting duplicate env assignments in an earlier cell -- would have created a second source of truth for the frozen config, the defect class behind the exp_061 v4 BLOCK.

admission_round_2.note: This was a correction to shared controller infrastructure, not to exp_062 alone; it unblocks the smoke gate for every experiment in this notebook lineage rather than waiving it.

admission_round_3.finding: DEMONSTRATED EXPLOIT, not a theoretical risk. The parent runs the patched predict script TWICE -- once for test inference (predict_cmd, the run that produces the submission) and once for validation (predict_val_cmd) -- and both append to the same telemetry file. Codex executed the frozen functions with memory-only filesystem substitutes and showed that a single 'val_single' validation record, with NO test-inference telemetry at all, passed read_stats() and produced exp062_mutual_best_integrity_passed: true. Validation activity could therefore substitute for missing candidate execution evidence.
admission_round_3.fix: Stage separation end to end. BIOHUB_EXP062_STAGE is set to 'test' before predict_cmd and to 'validation' before predict_val_cmd; every telemetry record carries the stage, and an 'unknown' stage is rejected outright. read_stats(require_stage='test') counts frames and frames_with_bonus for the REQUIRED STAGE ONLY, reports other stages separately in stage_counts/other_stage_records, and raises if no test-stage record exists. The finalize cell now passes require_stage='test' and expect_shards computed from the parent's ACTUAL launched shard set (worker_count/SLICE at the convergence point), so missing individual shards are caught too. Four new negative tests: validation-only telemetry, missing stage marker, duplicate shard, shard coverage mismatch.
admission_round_3.also_recorded: [VERIFICATION-DEPTH] PyTorch numerical parity of the numpy shim remains unverified locally; the shim establishes logic, not float-level parity. [VERIFICATION-DEPTH] The inherited validator is not specimen-disjoint and must never be presented as independent generalization evidence; the config already states this.
